code:
Data Source   -> fills the staging table (how data gets IN)
Staging table -> raw, unmodified rows
Transform Map -> maps staging columns to target fields
                 decides insert vs. update
Target table  -> sys_user, cmdb_ci, or a custom table
caption: The Transform Map decides what happens after staging.

code:
Staging column (imp_*)     Target field (sys_user)
first_name            ->   first_name
last_name             ->   last_name
emp_email             ->   email
dept_code             ->   department  (reference lookup)
caption: Column names don't have to match — the map is the translation.

code:
New staged row arrives
        |
        v
Does a target record match on the coalesce field?
   YES  -> UPDATE the existing record
   NO   -> INSERT a new record
caption: Without coalesce, every rerun just inserts duplicates.
